Team / Sam,

Quick weekly nudge on pipeline hygiene as we enter the May close window. Goals here: confirm final commit statuses, surface red/yellow/green flags, and lock simple save-plans for any at-risk deals. Please do two things by EOD Thursday:

1) Update the attached Q2_commit_tracker.xlsx — column "Finance Commit" (green/yellow/red) and "Expected PO/Sign date".
2) Reply with any immediate blockers and an owner for a 48-hour save-plan if the deal is red or late yellow.

Note on Acetex: Sam — appreciate the timeline visibility you shared last week. If procurement needs a SOW or pricing breakouts to finalize, flag it in your reply and we will prioritize.

Attachments: Q2_commit_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet: stage, ARR, owner), Acetex_MAPlist.xlsx (customer-facing MAP list; stub)

Thanks — short bullets preferred, we will synthesize and route to Finance and RevOps.

— Marcus

- DEAL-4529: currently yellow (pending legal redline + procurement confirmation). Owner: me (Marissa). Save-plan: provide a one-page SOW + 2-tier pricing options by Friday EOD; schedule a 30m procurement call with Sam.
- DEAL-4571: red — PO delayed, CFO request for usage cap language. Owner: Sean. Save-plan: escalate to RevOps and provide fallback model (short-term credits) while CFO reviews.

A few asks:
- Marcus / Priya — can you confirm whether Finance will accept an interim invoice arrangement for DEAL-4571 if Acetex signs before PO arrives?
- Sam — if legal needs a tracked SOW, I can prepare SOW_Acetex_v2.docx and circulate.

Thanks — I’ll join the procurement call if scheduled.

Marcus / Marissa / Sean — thanks for the note and the tracker. Quick status from procurement/legal side: 

- DEAL-4529: We marked it yellow. Procurement needs a tracked SOW (legal wants clarified data-handling language) and a final pricing exhibit. We can move to sign next week if those are provided.
- DEAL-4571: Holding as red; CFO is pushing for an internal usage cap before PO.

Actionable asks from our side:
- Please send the tracked SOW (SOW_Acetex_v2.docx) and a one-page pricing annex by Friday morning.
- If Redwood can offer a temporary credit/usage cap workaround, that will help accelerate CFO approval for DEAL-4571.

We will circulate comments via DocuSign for the SOW review window (I’ll route to legal).
